name: bg-indicator
description: See what is still running when Claude hands control back: a compact, live, multilingual band above the prompt, with each background task's scrollable log in a 10-line inset, or in a terminal window

trackBackground.title: Track background tasks
trackBackground.description: remind: tell Claude to start background work with run_in_background so the band shows it (default). block: also refuse commands that detach a process (&, nohup, setsid, disown). off: do neither.
